title: SBEE-2026 exam registration (mock)
task: Register me for the SBEE 2026 entrance exam and pay the application fee.

profile.name: Ananya Rao
profile.preferred_centre: any centre in the preferred city is fine

hints: The real registration link is a small 'Click here to register' link, not the big login links.
Date of birth is three dropdowns (DD, MM, YYYY). Mobile must be 10 digits with no +91.
Category labels may differ from the profile wording (e.g. General = GEN).

After a validation error the form reloads and its dropdowns reset. Before clicking Save & Continue, check that EVERY dropdown (DD, MM, YYYY and Category) shows a value; re-select any that show DD, MM, YYYY or '-- Select --'.

On the Fee page do three separate actions in this order: 1) click the small round radio button just left of the word UPI, 2) type the UPI ID into the name@bank box, 3) click Pay Now. If the page says 'Select UPI', the radio button is not selected: click it.

commits.name: fee_payment
commits.rejected_regex: Select UPI and enter a valid UPI ID
